Upper Right Quadrant Circular Arc Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Upper Right Quadrant Circular Arc because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+25DD, which you can use as ◝ in HTML, \25DD in CSS, or type with Alt+9693 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Upper Right Quadrant Circular Arc is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+25DD is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Upper Right Quadrant Circular Arc has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ◝ or the hex escape ◝.

How to type upper right quadrant circular arc on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 9 6 9 3 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 9693.
  4. Release Alt. The Upper Right Quadrant Circular Arc character (◝) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type upper right quadrant circular arc on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Upper Right Quadrant Circular Arc. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Upper Right Quadrant Circular Arc" and click the character to insert it.

How to use upper right quadrant circular arc in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\25DD"; ()
  • Python: \u25DD or chr(0x25DD)
  • JavaScript: \u25DD or String.fromCodePoint(0x25DD)
  • JSON: "\u25DD"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ◝?

No legacy Alt code exists for Upper Right Quadrant Circular Arc because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+25DD in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ◝ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ◝, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+9693 not work?

Alt+9693 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Upper Right Quadrant Circular Arc?

The Unicode codepoint for Upper Right Quadrant Circular Arc is U+25DD. You can use this value in HTML as ◝, in CSS as \25DD, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ◝ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+25DD, then click it.
